kotak-neo._comment: Official Kotak Neo MCP. Free. Holdings, positions, orders, place buy/sell, research recs.

kite._comment: Zerodha Kite MCP. Free hosted. 22 tools: profile, margins, quotes, historical, option chain, GTT. NEEDS OAUTH on first use.

upstox._comment: Upstox MCP. Read-only. Quotes, positions, holdings, technicals. NEEDS OAUTH.

dhan._comment: Dhan MCP. Full trading via natural language. FREE account at dhan.co. NEEDS OAUTH.

tapetide._comment: Tapetide MCP. 8,200 NSE/BSE stocks, 326-ratio screener, F&O OI, news. No broker account. Get free token at tapetide.com/settings/tokens.

finstack._comment: FinStack MCP. 95 tools. FII/DII, options chain, sentiment, peer compare. pip install finstack-mcp or uvx finstack-mcp.

openalgo._comment: OpenAlgo MCP. Exposes 30+ brokers (incl. Kotak) under one layer. pip install openalgo-mcp or use marketcalls/openalgo Docker image.

discovery._comment: For Claude Desktop: copy 'mcpServers' to ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Mac) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows). For Cursor: .cursor/mcp.json. For Windsurf: ~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json
